[attribute-xmlns-xsi]
=== `@xmlns:xsi` XML Schema Namespace Declaration

This is not an attribute, but a namespace pseudo-attribute. The value provides a URI to use for the `@xsi:schemaLocation` pseudo-attribute. All namespace prefixes must be associated with a URL, and the prefix “`xsi`” has been set to the URL for the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) XML Schema.

#### FIXED (not settable) on elements:  <<element-adoption,`<adoption>`>>, 
                  <<element-standard,`<standard>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance| The prefix “`xsi`” has been 
                        set to the URL for W3C XML Schema.
| Restriction| This attribute has a fixed value which may not be changed in the XML document.
|===
